title: Roles and responsibilities
text: Management shall define and assign IT security roles and responsibilities across the organisation.
version: Hong Kong DPO IT Security Guidelines (G3) v10.2, April 2025

title: Departmental IT security policy
text: A bureau/department-level IT security policy shall be documented and enforced, derived from the government baseline.
version: Hong Kong DPO IT Security Guidelines (G3) v10.2, April 2025

title: Evaluation and periodic review
text: The departmental IT security policy shall be evaluated and reviewed periodically to keep it current.
version: Hong Kong DPO IT Security Guidelines (G3) v10.2, April 2025

title: IT security responsibilities
text: IT security responsibilities shall be defined for staff when they are appointed, while in post, and on termination or change of role.
version: Hong Kong DPO IT Security Guidelines (G3) v10.2, April 2025

title: Security training
text: Staff shall receive security training appropriate to their role and responsibilities.
version: Hong Kong DPO IT Security Guidelines (G3) v10.2, April 2025

title: Inventory of assets
text: Assets associated with information and information processing facilities shall be identified and an inventory maintained.
version: Hong Kong DPO IT Security Guidelines (G3) v10.2, April 2025

title: Classification and labelling
text: Information shall be classified and labelled according to its sensitivity and the harm that could follow from disclosure.
version: Hong Kong DPO IT Security Guidelines (G3) v10.2, April 2025

title: Equipment and media control
text: Equipment and storage media holding information shall be controlled and protected against unauthorised access and removal.
version: Hong Kong DPO IT Security Guidelines (G3) v10.2, April 2025

title: Information erasure
text: Information shall be securely erased from media before disposal or reuse so that it cannot be recovered.
version: Hong Kong DPO IT Security Guidelines (G3) v10.2, April 2025

title: Principle of least privilege
text: Access to information and systems shall be granted on the principle of least privilege, limited to what the role requires.
version: Hong Kong DPO IT Security Guidelines (G3) v10.2, April 2025

title: Access control of classified information
text: Access to classified information shall be restricted by logical access control appropriate to its classification.
version: Hong Kong DPO IT Security Guidelines (G3) v10.2, April 2025

title: Data access control
text: Access rights shall be granted on a need-to-know basis, clearly defined, documented and reviewed periodically, with records of approval and review retained.
version: Hong Kong DPO IT Security Guidelines (G3) v10.2, April 2025

title: Controlling the use of special privileges
text: Administrative and other special privileges shall be restricted, controlled and reviewed, and their use should be independently checked.
version: Hong Kong DPO IT Security Guidelines (G3) v10.2, April 2025

title: Removal of access rights
text: Access rights shall be removed promptly when no longer required, including on personnel change or departure.
version: Hong Kong DPO IT Security Guidelines (G3) v10.2, April 2025

title: User identification
text: Each user shall be uniquely identifiable so that activity can be attributed to a single individual.
version: Hong Kong DPO IT Security Guidelines (G3) v10.2, April 2025

title: User accountability
text: Users are accountable for activity carried out under their own credentials.
version: Hong Kong DPO IT Security Guidelines (G3) v10.2, April 2025

title: Information access restriction
text: Access to systems and application functions shall be restricted to what the user is authorised to use.
version: Hong Kong DPO IT Security Guidelines (G3) v10.2, April 2025

title: Password policy
text: A documented password policy shall be defined per account category and enforced on all systems, covering minimum length, initial assignment, restricted words, password life cycle and selection rules, combined with password history and account lockout. A minimum length of at least eight characters shall be enforced where technically feasible.
version: Hong Kong DPO IT Security Guidelines (G3) v10.2, April 2025

title: Password selection
text: Users shall choose passwords that resist guessing, avoiding dictionary words, personal data and predictable patterns.
version: Hong Kong DPO IT Security Guidelines (G3) v10.2, April 2025

title: Compromising password
text: All default vendor passwords shall be changed before systems enter service, and compromised passwords shall be reset immediately.
version: Hong Kong DPO IT Security Guidelines (G3) v10.2, April 2025

title: Mobile computing and communications
text: Security requirements for mobile computing shall be defined, and measures adopted to prevent unauthorised access to or disclosure of information held on mobile devices.
version: Hong Kong DPO IT Security Guidelines (G3) v10.2, April 2025

title: Remote access and home office
text: Remote access, including home office arrangements, shall be governed by defined security requirements and controls over the channel and the endpoint.
version: Hong Kong DPO IT Security Guidelines (G3) v10.2, April 2025

title: IoT utilisation
text: IoT devices shall only be deployed where their use is justified, with security measures commensurate with the information they handle.
version: Hong Kong DPO IT Security Guidelines (G3) v10.2, April 2025

title: Data encryption
text: Encryption shall be applied to protect information in line with its classification, covering data in transit and at rest where required.
version: Hong Kong DPO IT Security Guidelines (G3) v10.2, April 2025

title: Cryptographic key management
text: Cryptographic keys shall be protected and managed through their life cycle, including generation, distribution, storage, and destruction.
version: Hong Kong DPO IT Security Guidelines (G3) v10.2, April 2025

title: Physical access control
text: Physical access to secure areas shall be restricted, authorised and recorded so that only permitted personnel can enter.
version: Hong Kong DPO IT Security Guidelines (G3) v10.2, April 2025

title: Principle of least functionality
text: Systems shall be configured with the minimum services, ports and components required for their function.
version: Hong Kong DPO IT Security Guidelines (G3) v10.2, April 2025

title: Change management
text: Changes to information systems shall go through a documented change management process with approval and rollback provision.
version: Hong Kong DPO IT Security Guidelines (G3) v10.2, April 2025

title: Malware detection and recovery
text: Malware detection and recovery measures shall be in place, with definitions kept current and suspected infections contained and reported.
version: Hong Kong DPO IT Security Guidelines (G3) v10.2, April 2025

title: Content filtering
text: Content filtering shall be used to reduce exposure to malicious or inappropriate content.
version: Hong Kong DPO IT Security Guidelines (G3) v10.2, April 2025

title: Data backup and recovery
text: Backup copies of information and software shall be taken and tested at regular intervals, and restoration shall be verified.
version: Hong Kong DPO IT Security Guidelines (G3) v10.2, April 2025

title: Backup devices and media
text: Backup devices and media shall be protected physically and logically, including during offsite transport and storage.
version: Hong Kong DPO IT Security Guidelines (G3) v10.2, April 2025

title: Log collection and retention
text: Activity logs shall be collected, protected against tampering, and retained for a defined period sufficient to support audit and investigation.
version: Hong Kong DPO IT Security Guidelines (G3) v10.2, April 2025

title: Installation of equipment and software
text: Installation of computer equipment and software shall be performed under controlled procedures to preserve the integrity of the environment.
version: Hong Kong DPO IT Security Guidelines (G3) v10.2, April 2025

title: Vulnerability management process
text: A vulnerability management process shall identify, evaluate, mitigate and track vulnerabilities on an ongoing basis.
version: Hong Kong DPO IT Security Guidelines (G3) v10.2, April 2025

title: Vulnerability scanning
text: Vulnerability scanning shall be performed regularly, with findings triaged and remediated according to risk.
version: Hong Kong DPO IT Security Guidelines (G3) v10.2, April 2025

title: Penetration testing
text: Penetration testing shall be performed periodically, and where systems are internet-facing or hold classified information, at a defined higher frequency.
version: Hong Kong DPO IT Security Guidelines (G3) v10.2, April 2025

title: Patch management
text: Patches shall be applied on a risk-based schedule, taking account of exploit likelihood and potential impact, with internet-facing systems prioritised.
version: Hong Kong DPO IT Security Guidelines (G3) v10.2, April 2025

title: Threat identification
text: Threat identification and detection mechanisms shall be established and kept current as the threat landscape changes.
version: Hong Kong DPO IT Security Guidelines (G3) v10.2, April 2025

title: Threat intelligence gathering
text: Threat intelligence from recognised sources shall be gathered and used to inform detection and response.
version: Hong Kong DPO IT Security Guidelines (G3) v10.2, April 2025

title: Internet security
text: Internet connectivity shall be secured, with the network boundary protected by firewalls and other gateway controls.
version: Hong Kong DPO IT Security Guidelines (G3) v10.2, April 2025

title: Gateway-level protection
text: Traffic crossing the network gateway shall be filtered and inspected, with rules reviewed periodically and default-deny applied where appropriate.
version: Hong Kong DPO IT Security Guidelines (G3) v10.2, April 2025

title: Transmission of classified information
text: Classified information shall only be transmitted over channels whose protection is commensurate with its classification.
version: Hong Kong DPO IT Security Guidelines (G3) v10.2, April 2025

title: Electronic messaging security
text: Electronic messaging shall be protected against interception and spoofing, with appropriate authentication and encryption controls.
version: Hong Kong DPO IT Security Guidelines (G3) v10.2, April 2025

title: Security by design
text: Security requirements shall be identified and built into information systems from the outset, including during acquisition.
version: Hong Kong DPO IT Security Guidelines (G3) v10.2, April 2025

title: Program and system testing
text: Security shall be tested as part of programme and system testing before systems are put into production.
version: Hong Kong DPO IT Security Guidelines (G3) v10.2, April 2025

title: Program and system change control
text: Changes to programs and systems shall be subject to formal change control so that security is not weakened.
version: Hong Kong DPO IT Security Guidelines (G3) v10.2, April 2025

title: Security requirements in contracts
text: Contracts with service providers shall contain the security requirements, obligations and service levels expected of them.
version: Hong Kong DPO IT Security Guidelines (G3) v10.2, April 2025

title: Monitoring and review of outsourcing
text: Outsourcing services shall be monitored and reviewed against the agreed security requirements and service levels.
version: Hong Kong DPO IT Security Guidelines (G3) v10.2, April 2025

title: Cloud shared responsibilities
text: For cloud services the security responsibilities of the provider and the bureau/department shall be clearly defined before an agreement is signed.
version: Hong Kong DPO IT Security Guidelines (G3) v10.2, April 2025

title: Incident monitoring and detection
text: Mechanisms shall exist to monitor for and detect security incidents in a timely manner.
version: Hong Kong DPO IT Security Guidelines (G3) v10.2, April 2025

title: Security incident reporting
text: Security incidents shall be reported immediately through a defined reporting route to the responsible party.
version: Hong Kong DPO IT Security Guidelines (G3) v10.2, April 2025

title: Security incident response
text: A documented incident response process shall be followed, covering containment, eradication, recovery and lessons learned.
version: Hong Kong DPO IT Security Guidelines (G3) v10.2, April 2025

title: Disaster recovery planning
text: Disaster recovery plans shall be documented, tested and reviewed so that critical services can be restored.
version: Hong Kong DPO IT Security Guidelines (G3) v10.2, April 2025

title: Availability of information systems
text: Information systems shall provide the resilience and availability required by the business, backed by redundancy where needed.
version: Hong Kong DPO IT Security Guidelines (G3) v10.2, April 2025

title: Data protection
text: Personal data shall be handled in accordance with the Personal Data (Privacy) Ordinance (Cap. 486).
version: Hong Kong DPO IT Security Guidelines (G3) v10.2, April 2025

title: Security risk assessment
text: Security risk assessments shall be conducted for information systems at a defined frequency and after significant change.
version: Hong Kong DPO IT Security Guidelines (G3) v10.2, April 2025

title: Security audit
text: Security audits shall be performed at a defined frequency, with findings tracked to remediation.
version: Hong Kong DPO IT Security Guidelines (G3) v10.2, April 2025
